job.job_description:
AI Engineer A bit about the role
Design, develop, and maintain AI-driven applications and solutions with a focus on reliability, scalability, and availability
Develop solutions using strong programming skills in Python, Java, C, C++, or JavaScript
Design and implement Agentic AI solutions using AI agents, workflow orchestration, and autonomous task execution
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into applications, workflows, and enterprise solutions
Develop, test, and optimize prompts for reliable and effective LLM-based outcomes
Build and maintain AI workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies
Develop and integrate APIs to connect AI solutions with enterprise applications, data sources, and external services
Create AI-driven automation solutions for repetitive tasks and business processes
Design and deploy cloud-native AI solutions on OCI and AWS
Troubleshoot AI application, integration, and workflow issues and support incident resolution
Follow software engineering and operational processes, including testing, version control, deployment, change management, and incident handling
A bit about you
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C, C++, or JavaScript
Strong understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, workflow orchestration, and autonomous task execution
Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
API integration and software engineering fundamentals
AI-driven automation and solution development
Cloud-native AI solution development on OCI and/or AWS
Additional information
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
Benefits
